content.personality:
Focus on writing perfect programs and program execution performance, and hope that the program code is easy to maintain.

The information technology industry is changing very fast, and I have to keep learning new things so that I won't be eliminated. Therefore, I always force myself to get out of the comfort zone, keep learning new things, and also train my brain so that my reaction and memory will not decline as I get older.

When I was 24, I started improving my English skills to have more opportunities and stand out from other engineers.
